newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer says he noted Rubin's comments.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer says he noted Rubin's comments.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said he had taken note of U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin's Friday comments on the dollar with great interest and thought they were important.
"I noted his comments with interest. I believe this is an important statement," Tietmeyer told journalists ahead of the G7 economic summit in Berlin.

On Friday Rubin diverted slightly from the usual U.S. line calling for ever strong dollar, by saying that the currency had been strong for some time. The comments sent dollar two pfennigs down on late Friday oven though it recovered some losses before close.
